question: Who among the following inaugurated seventh edition of the Khelo India Youth Games 2025 held at Bihar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The seventh edition of the Khelo India Youth Games 2025 was inaugurated by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**.
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is an initiative aimed at promoting sports culture and identifying young talent across India.
 
• This edition was held in the state of Bihar, marking a significant milestone for the state in hosting national-level sports events.
 
• The **Khelo India program**, launched in 2018, emphasizes grassroots-level participation and the development of sports infrastructure.
 
• Under Narendra Modi’s leadership, the government has consistently promoted sports and fitness initiatives, including campaigns like **“Fit India Movement”** and the expansion of the Khelo India program.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arif Mohammad Khan:**

 
 
• Arif Mohammad Khan is the current Governor of Kerala, having assumed office in September 2019.
 
• He is a veteran politician and has been part of various political parties during his career.
 
 
 
• **Nitish Kumar:**
 
 
• Nitish Kumar is the Chief Minister of Bihar and has served multiple terms in this role.
 
• While he plays a significant role in the development of Bihar, including promoting sports infrastructure, the inauguration of the Khelo India Youth Games 2025 was conducted by the Prime Minister.
 
 
 
• **Mansukh Mandaviya:**
 
 
• Mansukh Mandaviya is the Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare as of 2023.
 
• He is primarily known for his work in healthcare reforms, including initiatives like Ayushman Bharat and vaccination drives.
